subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Then more notes appeared.”?
options: Before graduation, students were allowed to write messages on each other's uniforms.
Many students thought it would be easy.
Soon, many desks had small messages inside.
Now students write many kinds of messages.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Before graduation, students were allowed to write messages on each other's uniforms.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Many students thought it would be easy.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Soon, many desks had small messages inside.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Then more notes appeared. Now students write many kinds of messages.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Then more notes appeared. Now students write many kinds of messages.」，答案為「Now students write many kinds of messages.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Now students write many kinds of messages.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
